zh: 正着走每一步都有两种选择，分支太多；反过来从目标往回推，每一步的前驱却是唯一的：坐标都为正，较大的那一维一定是最后一步加出来的。
若 tx > ty，上一步一定是 (tx − ty, ty)；连续多次同方向的回退可以用取模一次跳过，即 tx %= ty。但要小心：当 ty 已经等于 sy 时不能再取模越过起点，此时只需判断 (tx − sx) 能否被 ty 整除。ty > tx 的情况对称。
循环条件是 tx ≥ sx 且 ty ≥ sy：两维都相等时输出 Yes；tx > ty 时，若 ty == sy 就返回 (tx − sx) % ty == 0 的结果，否则 tx %= ty；反之对称处理 ty。循环退出说明越过了起点，输出 No。用 64 位整数。
en: Going forward, every step has two choices and the branching explodes; going backward from the target, each step has a unique predecessor: both coordinates are positive, so the larger one must have been produced by the last step.

If tx > ty, the previous point must be (tx - ty, ty), and a run of repeated steps in that direction collapses into one modulo, tx %= ty. Be careful: once ty already equals sy you must not jump past the start with the modulo; just check whether (tx - sx) is divisible by ty. The case ty > tx is symmetric.

Loop while tx >= sx and ty >= sy: if both coordinates match, print Yes; if tx > ty, return whether (tx - sx) % ty == 0 when ty == sy, otherwise set tx %= ty; handle ty symmetrically. Leaving the loop means you went past the start, so print No. Use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Reconstruct backwards from the target. If tx>ty, the last step can only have increased the first coordinate by ty, so the predecessor's first coordinate is tx-ty; repeated backward steps can be skipped in one go with a modulo. Handle ty>tx symmetrically. If one coordinate already equals the corresponding starting value, the other coordinate must be able to return to the start in steps of the fixed size, that is, by exact division.

## Correctness

Each forward operation increases only one coordinate, and the increase is exactly the other positive coordinate. Therefore the larger coordinate determines the last step and the unique predecessor; consecutive subtractions in the same direction can be merged with a modulo. Reaching the start means success; overshooting the start, or a remainder mismatch while the other coordinate is fixed, means no valid chain of predecessors can exist.

## Complexity

Each modulo shrinks one coordinate significantly, for O(log(max(tx,ty))) time and O(1) space.
